tai-khoan-da-luu.title: Saved
tai-khoan-da-luu.description: Favourite tools, saved results and source-check history of your Chuyện Nhỏ account.

bar.title: Save to your account
bar.text: Save the figures you entered and reopen them on another device. They are stored on the Chuyện Nhỏ server, tied to your account.
bar.readOnly: Your Pro plan has ended: you can still open past results but cannot save new ones.
bar.nameLabel: A name to find it later
bar.conflict: “{{title}}” was just changed on another device at {{date}}. Overwrite it with the figures on this screen?
bar.restoreFailed: This item could not be opened: the saved data does not match the current version of the tool.

card.title: Saved
card.text: Favourite tools, saved results and source-check history, shared across every device you sign in on.
card.readOnly: Your Pro plan has ended. Saved items can still be viewed and deleted.

page.title: <accent>Saved</accent> items
page.intro: Your favourite tools, saved results and source-check history. The same on every device.

invite.title: Saving and sync are Pro features
invite.text: With Pro you can save electricity, payroll and address-conversion results, mark favourite tools and review your source checks on every device.

page.readOnly: Your Pro plan has ended. You can still view, open and delete past items but cannot save new ones.
page.syncNote: Refreshes when you come back to this page and every minute.
page.noFavourites: No tools yet. Press “Add to favourites” at the top of a tool page to pin it here.
page.noResults: No results yet. In Electricity, Payroll or Address conversion, press “Save result”.
page.removeConfirm: Delete “{{title}}”? It will disappear on every device.

history.title: Source-check history
history.text: Every time you ran an AI source check in a tool. Chuyện Nhỏ keeps only the tool, the time and the draft outcome, never your questions.

errors.SIGNED_OUT: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.PRO_REQUIRED: Saving to your account is a Pro feature.
errors.UNTRUSTED_REQUEST: The browser blocked this request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: The data to save is not valid.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item no longer exists (it may have been deleted on another device).
errors.SAVED_CONFLICT: This item was just changed on another device.
errors.CLOUD_QUOTA: Your storage is full. Delete some older items.
errors.CLOUD_ITEM_TOO_LARGE: This result is too large to save (256 KB at most).
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.
